title: qxmd177 · Marks mobile Check Answer (no Q jump to top) + stable in-flow Solution
body: Fix qxmd176 top-jump: remove scrollTop=0 on Check/Show Answer; capture/restore scroll across reveal+refresh; Marks-like in-flow sol under metadata; opts hide after sol paint (no broken stack); Show Answer sync kept; mobile Clear hidden; Prev/Next visible; Quantrex brand; no Vercel.
